description: This PHP class extends a monolog stream handler to override the write method, incorporating dependency injection to check if the log file is writable via a service container. It is part of the OrangeHRM Installer framework, specifically within the StreamHandler component.

classes.name: StreamHandler
classes.description: A custom handler extending Monolog's StreamHandler to include dependency injection-based checks for log file writability before writing logs.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides the parent write method to check if the HTTP kernel service exists and if the log file is writable before proceeding with logging.
